name: Supplication
summary: Someone begs a power for protection or mercy; the power's decision hangs in doubt.
elements: a persecutor, a suppliant, a power in authority whose decision is uncertain

name: Deliverance
summary: Someone condemned or trapped is rescued by an unexpected hand.
elements: an unfortunate, a threatener, a rescuer

name: Crime pursued by vengeance
summary: A wrong is answered with vengeance that the law would not give.
elements: an avenger, a criminal, the wrong between them

name: Vengeance taken for kin upon kin
summary: One relative avenges another against a third relative.
elements: an avenging kinsman, a guilty kinsman, the victim they share

name: Pursuit
summary: A fugitive runs; the pursuit, not the crime, is the story.
elements: a fugitive, a pursuer, a punishment that waits

name: Disaster
summary: A power falls; the mighty are brought down by defeat, catastrophe or betrayal.
elements: a vanquished power, a victorious enemy or messenger of ruin

name: Falling prey to cruelty or misfortune
summary: An innocent is at the mercy of someone or something merciless.
elements: an unfortunate, a master or a misfortune

name: Revolt
summary: One person, or a few, rise against an authority that seemed beyond challenge.
elements: a tyrant, a conspirator

name: Daring enterprise
summary: A bold undertaking against the odds: a theft, a rescue, a conquest.
elements: a bold leader, an object to win, an adversary

name: Abduction
summary: Someone is taken; someone else must get them back.
elements: an abductor, the abducted, a guardian

name: The enigma
summary: A riddle must be solved, and the price of failing is high.
elements: an interrogator, a seeker, a problem

name: Obtaining
summary: Something is wanted and can be had only by persuasion, cunning or force.
elements: a solicitor, an adversary who refuses, or an arbitrator between them

name: Enmity of kin
summary: Hatred inside a family: a parent and a child, two siblings, a couple.
elements: a malevolent kinsman, a hated or reciprocally hating kinsman

name: Rivalry of kin
summary: Two relatives want the same person or prize.
elements: the preferred kinsman, the rejected kinsman, the object

name: Murderous adultery
summary: Lovers who want the spouse gone, or a spouse who learns it.
elements: two adulterers, a betrayed spouse

name: Madness
summary: Someone loses their reason and harms what they love, or is believed mad and is not.
elements: a madman, a victim

name: Fatal imprudence
summary: A careless act, a curiosity or a boast sets ruin in motion.
elements: the imprudent one, the victim or the lost object

name: Involuntary crimes of love
summary: A love that was innocent turns out to be forbidden; the discovery is the blow.
elements: a lover, the beloved, the revealer

name: Slaying of a kinsman unrecognized
summary: Harm is done to someone whose identity is unknown until it is too late.
elements: the slayer, the unrecognized victim

name: Self-sacrifice for an ideal
summary: Someone gives up love, fortune or life for a belief.
elements: a hero, the ideal, the person or thing sacrificed

name: Self-sacrifice for kin
summary: Someone gives up their own happiness or safety for a relative.
elements: a hero, a kinsman, the person or thing sacrificed

name: All sacrificed for passion
summary: A passion costs everything: honour, duty, a future.
elements: a lover, the object of the passion, the person or thing sacrificed

name: Necessity of sacrificing loved ones
summary: Duty or a vow forces someone to give up a person they love.
elements: a hero, a beloved victim, the necessity

name: Rivalry of superior and inferior
summary: Two unequal rivals, in rank, wealth or power, want the same thing.
elements: a superior rival, an inferior rival, the object

name: Adultery
summary: A betrayal of a partner, with its discovery, its cost or its silence.
elements: a deceived spouse, two adulterers

name: Crimes of love
summary: A love that breaks a law or a taboo and knows it.
elements: a lover, the beloved

name: Discovery of the dishonour of a loved one
summary: Someone learns that a person they love has done something shameful.
elements: the discoverer, the guilty one

name: Obstacles to love
summary: Two people want each other; class, family, distance or a vow stands between.
elements: two lovers, an obstacle

name: An enemy loved
summary: Someone loves a person their own side hates, or who has harmed them.
elements: the beloved enemy, the lover, the hater

name: Ambition
summary: Someone wants to rise and what it costs those around them.
elements: an ambitious person, a thing coveted, an adversary

name: Conflict with a god
summary: A mortal defies a power that cannot be beaten: fate, the system, the sea.
elements: a mortal, an immortal or an unbeatable power

name: Mistaken jealousy
summary: Jealousy built on a misreading, fed by someone who profits from it.
elements: the jealous one, the object of jealousy, the supposed accomplice, the cause or the author of the mistake

name: Erroneous judgment
summary: An innocent is blamed; the real cause is nearer than anyone looks.
elements: the mistaken one, the victim of the mistake, the cause or author of the mistake, the guilty one

name: Remorse
summary: A guilt that will not stay buried drives the story.
elements: the culprit, the victim or the sin, the interrogator

name: Recovery of a lost one
summary: Someone believed gone is found, and is not who they were.
elements: the seeker, the one found

name: Loss of loved ones
summary: Someone watches a loss they cannot prevent, or learns of it.
elements: a kinsman slain, a kinsman spectator, an executioner

name: In medias res
summary: Open in the middle of the crisis; the beginning is given back later, in pieces, only as it changes what we see.
elements: an opening with no setup; a return to the start that re-reads the opening

name: Frame story
summary: The story is told by someone inside another situation, and the frame has its own turn at the end.
elements: a teller, a listener with a stake, a frame that closes differently from how it opened

name: Kishōtenketsu
summary: Four movements with no antagonist: introduction, development, a twist that recontextualises, a reconciliation of the two.
elements: no villain; a third movement that changes the meaning of the first two

name: Reverse chronology
summary: Scenes run backwards; each one explains the one we have already seen.
elements: an ending shown first; causes revealed as consequences are already known

name: Two accounts
summary: The same event told twice by two people who both believe themselves; the gap is the story.
elements: one event, two tellings, a detail that differs and matters

name: Bottle
summary: One place, continuous time, nobody can leave until something is settled.
elements: a single location, a reason the door stays shut, a clock

name: False protagonist
summary: The person we follow at first is not the story's centre; the hand-over is the turn.
elements: a first lead, a moment of hand-over, the real lead

name: Told through documents
summary: The story is carried by messages, voicemails, receipts, recordings: what people write when they think no one else reads.
elements: documents as scenes, a reader who assembles them, one document that lies

name: The planted thing that never fires
summary: An object or threat is set up with care and never used; what strikes is something nobody set up.
elements: a conspicuous setup, its refusal, an unplanted blow

name: Parallel lines
summary: Two strangers' stories alternate and touch only once, late, through a small act.
elements: two leads who do not know each other, one shared object or place, a single touch
